description: Auditor-side delegation-key escrow: dvk_cipher_aud = dvk + Poseidon2(ESC_DVK_AUD, s_a_s, op_i) where s_a_s = ecdh(r_e, K_aud_s) is the owner-auditor shared scalar. Same plaintext and same shape as encrypt_esc_dvk, under a distinct tag (17 rather than 10) and a distinct shared scalar: this one goes to the owner's auditor, the other to the spender. Holding dvk_i is what lets the auditor derive r_a = derive_allow_r(dvk_i, sigma_a) and therefore open the allowance commitment C_a.
